scope: Private C5 MSPI clock observations and source-dependent functional gates; no bus/soc/transport/shared edits

API.default: None/false; a zero RC rate is treated as None.
API.owner: The parent supplies observations from real analog and clock state; MSPI does not create a source.
API.reset: PCR module reset preserves external observations; a fresh object or die copy does not invent them.

selectors.2: PLL_F480M only with external readiness and PCR_PLL_CLK_EN

fastDivider.PLL: Ignored; this divider applies only to low-speed sources.

serialClock.divider: source/(N+1); existing phase encoding checks are retained.

caseCoverage: Missing RC/PLL remains unsupported; ROM compatibility cannot invent PLL readiness.
PLL loss denies mapped flash and commands; a valid PLL allows actual backing bytes and subsequent backing changes.
A denied command preserves buffers and raw interrupt state; selector3 remains unsupported.
MMU power-down, AXI closure and encrypted entries still block mapped flash.
XTAL48MHz and supplied RC17.5MHz use independent div1/div2/div4 rates.
Supplied RC permits real mapped bytes and dedicated flash reads; withdrawal denies both.
The existing virtual8MiB PSRAM performs a QPI write/read at80MHz after serial20MHz setup.
PSRAM pads, opcodes and frequency limits remain required.
PCR reset retains external observations; a fresh die copy keeps them absent.
Explicit source withdrawal survives PCR reset.

checks.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/c5-mspi-clock-lane CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p esp32c5 --test psram -- --skip original_sram_guest --nocapture

limits: Clock integration preparation only; no factory execution on MSPI_PLL is claimed.
The parent must refresh observations on actual events, clear them with modes and restore them from retained analog state as appropriate.
The flash byte check uses actual MMU translation and backing-array bytes in a module test; it does not claim new CPU guest execution.
The synchronous functional engine remains; physical clock waveform, transfer latency and flash maximum-rate accuracy are outside this change.
The long original SRAM PSRAM guest was filtered from this focused run; the parent owns broader regression.
No bus/soc/transport/shared/core/per-tick change, broad build, benchmark, browser, push, firmware edit or validation bypass.
privacy: Only public source hashes and aggregate checks are retained; raw logs and absolute workspace identities are omitted.
